analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW — November 6, 2026

MARKET REGIME: MIXED/BEARISH. SPY is -4.3% below its SMA50 with only a marginal positive 20d slope. This is not a regime that rewards aggressive new buying — it rewards patience and capital protection. Deployment is already at 86% (6 positions), which is above the 3-5 concentrated-position target by count.

POSITION REVIEW:
• ADSK (+6.82%): Clean uptrend, thesis intact. Hold.
• FOXA (+3.01%): Confirmed uptrend basing at 71% of 52w range. Still in screened candidates with solid fundamentals. Hold.
• UHS (+12.09%): Best performer — healthcare defensive with real momentum. Thesis intact. Hold.
• ULTA (+8.35%): Strong recovery, thesis intact. Monitor for extended condition but not there yet.
• NXPI (-2.77%): Still in screened candidates as 'UPTREND basing' with SMA50 slope +2.2% and fwd P/E 13.33 — thesis intact. The slight drawdown reflects normal volatility within a constructive base. No action needed unless stop is threatened.
• AMP (-6.91%): AMP does NOT appear in the screened candidates list — meaning it has failed either the trend filter or quality filter this cycle. This is a thesis-break signal. At -6.91% and deteriorating trend, this position deserves heightened scrutiny. If a stop was placed around 7-10% below entry (~$495-510), AMP is approaching that level. Recommend reviewing against original stop discipline and exiting if stop is hit or trend confirmation is absent.

CAPACITY: Only $9,099 of headroom remains under the 95% gross cap. Even the most attractively sized new position (e.g., 200 shares of a $40 stock) would represent <0.5% of equity at risk — too small to move the needle and too thinly sized to be meaningful. Forcing a trade into this constrained space violates the sizing discipline.

NEW SETUPS REVIEWED: Several compelling candidates exist on a standalone basis — TXN (strong uptrend, 14.6% EPS revision, PEG 0.94), REGN (uptrend, 23.3% EPS revision, strong FCF), UNH (79% range, uptrend, 3.8% EPS revision). However, all require $15,000-$25,000 positions for proper 1-2% heat sizing, which exceeds available headroom by 2-3x. Undersizing a conviction trade is nearly as bad as not making it — it produces negligible portfolio impact while creating execution overhead.

CONCLUSION: The correct action today is ZERO new buys. The book is well-deployed, the market regime is mixed, and there is insufficient headroom for a properly sized new position. Protect the winners (UHS, ULTA, ADSK), monitor AMP's stop level closely, and let cash rebuild as capacity is restored. Capital preservation is the win here.
